title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 3, section 4 (After 3 consecutive days of DGR IV, cease activity between 1 p.m. local time and sunset each day)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 3 [en. B.C. Reg. 157/2020, s. 9; am. B.C. Regs. 83/2022; 110/2023, s. 13.] Restrictions on High Risk Activities Item Column 1 Fire Danger Class (DGR) Column 2 Restriction Column 3
After 3 consecutive days of DGR IV, cease activity between 1 p.m. local time and sunset each day
4 V (extreme) Cease activity between 1 p.m. local time and sunset each day and maintain a fire watcher immediately after the high risk activity ends for a minimum of 2 hours Until after the fire danger class falls below DGR IV for 2 or more consecutive days After 3 consecutive days of DGR V, cease activity all day Until after the fire danger class falls to DGR IV for 3 or more consecutive days or falls below DGR IV
